definitions.explanation: A large bell, especially those in temples or churches.

examples.english: I like the sound of bells.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{鐘|かね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。

examples.english: I can hear the sound of the temple bell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{除夜|じょや}→除夜：14590_joya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鐘|かね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大晦日|おおみそか}→大晦日：05810_oomisoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧108⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦{突|つ}かれる→突く：12735_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The New Year's Eve bell is struck 108 times on New Year's Eve night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鐘|かね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告|つ}げる→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧。⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: The old church bell announces the time. The townspeople tell the time by its sound.

notes:
{鐘|かね} refers to large bells, especially temple bells.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {鐘|かね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ (the bell rings)
- {鐘|かね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧/⟦{撞|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to strike a bell)
- {鐘|かね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|ね}→音：00743_oto⟧ (the sound of the bell)

CULTURAL NOTES:
- ⟦{除夜|じょや}→除夜：14590_joya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鐘|かね} (New Year's Eve bell - rung 108 times)
- Temple bells (⟦{梵鐘|ぼんしょう}→梵鐘：28012_bonshou⟧) are important in Buddhism

HOMOPHONE:
- ⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧ (money) - different kanji

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鐘|かね}: large bell (temple, church)
- ⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧: bell (small, electric)
- ⟦{鈴|すず}→鈴：03890_suzu⟧: small bell, jingle bell
